component.name: VPN Unlimited
component.summary: Fast and private VPN with no traffic or speed limits

description.p: VPN Unlimited is a cross-platform VPN service with no limits on traffic or connection speed. It encrypts your connection, hides your real IP address and lets you choose where your traffic leaves the internet, across servers in more than 80 locations.

It installs no background service and no kernel module: the tunnel is created through NetworkManager, the network service your system already runs, using the WireGuard protocol. Settings live inside the Flatpak sandbox, so removing the application removes them with it.

ul.li: WireGuard tunnel set up through NetworkManager
Servers in over 80 locations, with a recommended-server option
Zero-log policy: your online activity is not recorded
Custom DNS, so you decide who resolves your names
Optional personal VPN server with a dedicated IP, available as a separate purchase
Works on Steam Deck in both Desktop and Game Mode
Customer support reachable from the application and on the website

description.p: A VPN Unlimited account is required. You can create one from the application or on our website.
VPN performance and availability may vary by country, network, protocol, server, and local restrictions. Some services or websites may block VPN connections.
